subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The nurses still gave care.”?
options: The best system knows when to stop pretending it understands and call a human.
Sometimes a place changes not because it becomes larger or newer, but because it gives people time to stop.
Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
